"import csv
from docx import Document

CSV_PATH = "load_01.csv"
OUT_PATH = "report.docx"
REQUIRED = ["case", "load_factor", "cycles"]


def norm(s: str) -> str:
    return s.strip().lower().replace(" ", "_").replace("-", "_")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Read the source data, preserving the original text formatting
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
with open(CSV_PATH, newline="", encoding="utf-8-sig") as f:
    reader = csv.reader(f)
    header = next(reader)
    raw_rows = [row for row in reader if any(c.strip() for c in row)]

norm_cols = [norm(c) for c in header]
idx = {}
for name in REQUIRED:
    if name in norm_cols:
        idx[name] = norm_cols.index(name)
    else:
        raise KeyError(f"Required column '{name}' not found in {CSV_PATH}: {header}")

table_rows = []
load_values = []
cycle_values = []
for row in raw_rows:
    case_raw = row[idx["case"]].strip()
    load_raw = row[idx["load_factor"]].strip()
    cycles_raw = row[idx["cycles"]].strip()
    table_rows.append((case_raw, load_raw, cycles_raw))
    load_values.append(float(load_raw))
    cycle_values.append(int(float(cycles_raw)))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Compute statistics from the CSV values (no hand-entered numbers)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
n = len(table_rows)
max_load = max(load_values)
mean_load = sum(load_values) / n
total_cycles = sum(cycle_values)


def fmt(x: float, nd: int = 2) -> str:
    """Round to nd decimals and trim trailing zeros (2.35 -> '2.35', 1.70 -> '1.7')."""
    s = f"{x:.{nd}f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")
    return s if s else "0"


max_disp = fmt(max_load, 2)
mean_disp = fmt(mean_load, 2)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Build the document
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
doc = Document()

# Title (Heading)
doc.add_heading("Engineering Test Report — Load Case 01", level=1)

# Overview
doc.add_heading("Overview", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"This report summarizes the engineering load-test data recorded in {CSV_PATH}. "
    f"The input file contains N = {n} data rows (test records), excluding the header row."
)

# Results table
doc.add_heading("Results table", level=1)
table = doc.add_table(rows=1, cols=len(REQUIRED))
try:
    table.style = "Table Grid"
except KeyError:
    pass

for j, name in enumerate(REQUIRED):
    cell = table.rows[0].cells[j]
    run = cell.paragraphs[0].add_run(name)
    run.bold = True

for case_raw, load_raw, cycles_raw in table_rows:
    cells = table.add_row().cells
    cells[0].text = case_raw
    cells[1].text = load_raw
    cells[2].text = cycles_raw

# Summary (values computed above, formatted as specified)
doc.add_heading("Summary", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    f"Across the dataset, N cases = {n}. The recorded load factors reached a "
    f"load max = {max_disp}, with a load mean = {mean_disp} over all runs. "
    f"The accumulated endurance testing amounts to total cycles = {total_cycles}."
)

# Conclusion
doc.add_heading("Conclusion", level=1)
doc.add_paragraph(
    "The measurements summarized above were computed directly from the source data file, "
    "and the complete record set is reproduced verbatim in the results table. The aggregate "
    "statistics reported in the summary section can each be traced back to the individual "
    "data rows, so this document may serve as the reference record for any follow-on "
    "structural assessment of this load case."
)

doc.save(OUT_PATH)
print(f"Wrote {OUT_PATH}: {n} data rows, {len(table.rows)} table rows (1 header + {n}).")"
